why: Software project management / project scheduling tools (PERT vs Gantt). The 2026 syllabus has no software engineering or project management unit. The words 'network diagram' brush against TECH1 Unit 1 'Graph theory, trees and graph algorithms', but the question tests recognition of a PM charting tool, not any graph-theoretic property or algorithm.
Software process models — the defining feature of the Spiral model. Software engineering was dropped entirely from the 2026 syllabus; no TECH1 or TECH2 unit covers SDLC process models.
Software process models (Iterative Enhancement vs Waterfall vs Prototyping). Software engineering / SDLC is not in the 2026 syllabus.
Software process models — drawbacks of the Spiral model. No unit of TECH1 or TECH2 covers software engineering process models.
Software testing — black-box test design techniques (boundary value analysis vs equivalence partitioning). Testing is part of software engineering, which the 2026 syllabus does not contain.
Requirements engineering — contents of an SRS document. The brief names SRS explicitly as dropped software engineering material.
Software design methodology — the common characteristics of software design methods (notation, refinement heuristics, quality assessment). Software engineering design is not in the 2026 syllabus.
Software quality assurance — verification vs validation. SQA is software engineering, which the 2026 syllabus dropped.

Software size/effort estimation via KLOC and function points. Software project estimation is software engineering; note this is unrelated to TECH1 Unit 3's 'Algorithm development and complexity', which is about asymptotic algorithmic cost, not project metrics.
Criteria for selecting a software process model. Software engineering / SDLC, absent from the 2026 syllabus.
Comparison of software process models on when requirements are fixed. Software engineering process models are not in the 2026 syllabus.
Software process quality attributes (productivity, timeliness, visibility) versus product attributes. Software engineering quality material, not covered by any 2026 unit.
Purpose/goals of a software process. Software engineering, dropped from the 2026 syllabus.
The three generic phases of software engineering (definition, development, support). Explicitly software engineering, absent from TECH1 and TECH2.
Stakeholder identification in requirements engineering / systems analysis. The brief lists systems analysis and requirements work as dropped material.
The ordering of SDLC phases. SDLC is software engineering and systems analysis, which the 2026 syllabus does not contain.

Areas of concern in the software design phase (architecture, data, interface). This is software-engineering design, not TECH1 Unit 2 computer architecture and not TECH2 Unit 2's MVC/microservices leaf — the word 'Architecture' here is an answer option about design-phase scope.
Software design metrics — whether architectural design metrics are black-box in nature. Software engineering metrics; no 2026 unit covers them.

Software product quality attributes (the question describes availability but the printed options offer reliability/usability/efficiency/functionality). Software quality characteristics are software engineering, outside the 2026 syllabus.
Attributes of good software (maintainability, functionality) — software engineering product quality. Not covered by any TECH1 or TECH2 unit.
